name: Easy Advanced Translations
summary: AI Shopify store translation (by Northwest): translate products, collections, theme text, metafields and even hard-coded and third-party-app text across languages, with a choice of engine (its own, Google, OpenAI or DeepSeek), image translation, protected terms and Shopify Markets support.
best_for: small-to-mid Shopify stores that want affordable, full-store AI translation (including images and third-party-app text) and are comfortable bringing their own OpenAI or DeepSeek key for unlimited volume
skip_if: you run a large catalogue and want predictable all-in pricing without managing API keys or quotas, you require a proven app with a large review base, or you need SLA and support guarantees
honest_knock: The 'free AI' is quota-limited (50 products on Free, up to 3,000 on Pro) and past the quota the paid plans bill pay-as-you-go (with a spend limit), so a large multilingual catalogue costs more than the sticker price, or pushes you to your own OpenAI/DeepSeek key, where you pay token costs separately on top of the subscription. Auto AI Translations, which handle new or changed content, sit on Pro only, at $29.99 a month (listing and our own test session on 17 November 2026). And the track record is thin: 5.0 stars but only twelve reviews on 17 November 2026, the app launched in July 2025, and it carries no 'Built for Shopify' badge: cheap and promising, but unproven.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/advanced-translation and in our own test session on 17 November 2026) Four monthly tiers billed in USD: Free, Starter at $4.99, Basic at $19.99 and Pro at $29.99. Free installs at no cost and gives you unlimited AI if you bring your own OpenAI or DeepSeek key, or free built-in AI for a small quota (50 products, 50 metafields, 100 variants, 5 articles) in one AI language. Starter is $4.99 (400 products, 400 metafields and 50 articles; up to 3 languages), Basic $19.99 (1,500 products and metafields, 150 articles; AI for 10 languages) and Pro $29.99 (3,000 products and metafields, 300 articles; AI for 20 languages, plus Auto AI Translations) — or, again, unlimited if you supply your own key. Beyond the built-in quota the paid plans switch to pay-as-you-go with a spend limit you set. The model's real pivot is that key: bring your own and you pay the AI provider's token costs directly for unlimited volume; rely on the built-in free AI and you are capped per tier, then billed per use. Auto AI Translations, which translate new and edited content on their own, appear on the Pro card only. In our own test session on 17 November 2026 the plan screen in the app showed the same four tiers and prices, with Auto AI Translations on Pro only.

compare_with.name: Weglot
compare_with.why: Weglot is the established, higher-priced incumbent for Shopify translation; Easy Advanced Translations undercuts it sharply and translates deeper into theme and third-party text, but with a young twelve review record and a bring-your-own-AI-key model rather than Weglot's all-in pricing. Pick Weglot for a proven managed service, this for price and depth if you will manage a key

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Easy Advanced Translations on a Shopify development store: the install on the Free plan, adding Dutch, translating the products with the built-in AI engine in about 2 minutes (not published), the four plans with Basic at $19.99 and Auto AI Translations only on Pro, and the Starter approval screen, which asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence, so it was not approved. The language was deleted and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Nothing was paid and nothing was saved in the theme. Install: the install was started at 16:42 in our own tab and the dialog This app needs access to (View customer data, View staff and contributor data, View and edit store data) was approved at about 16:44. The admin was in English. The app opened straight on the Plans tab with the Free plan active: no payment, no account on the vendor site and no card were asked. The tabs are Languages, AI Translate, Manual Translation, App Widgets, Preset Terms (Glossary) and Plans. Languages said Languages added: 0 out of 20 and Default store language: English. Core action, add Dutch and translate the products automatically: at 16:47 Dutch was chosen in Select a Language and added with Add Language +. Dutch stood in the list at once with Published off and Available on Market(s) None. It was not published: publishing asks for a market, and we made no market and no theme change. On the tab AI Translate the engine was Current AI translation engine: Built-in AI, and Add languages to AI said You are on the FREE plan. You can select up to 1 more languages for AI translations. and that once a language is enabled for AI translations, it can only be removed by deleting the language from the Shopify store. The resource Products was ticked (Title, Meta title, Meta description, Body HTML and Product type, shown as Not translated or outdated); there is no choice for one single product, all products go along (the development store has few products, inside the free 50). Start Translating first showed Wait! Before you start the translations (check the Preset Terms and the engine) and then Yes, I'm ready to start translating, after which the page said Translating your content... Please wait until the process completes. It was ready after about 2 minutes (started at 16:50, ready around 16:52), in 4 clicks and 2 confirmations from the language. The result in Manual Translation, Dutch, Products: the title The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard became Het niet-geregistreerde snowboard in de inventaris; the handle stayed empty and the product type snowboard stayed the same; about 9 result pages. From the install to the first translated result took about 10 minutes (16:42 to about 16:52). Only the title was read for quality. Plans: Free $0 a month (Unlimited AI with your own API key, or FREE AI for 50 products, 50 metafields, 5 articles; up to 1 AI Language; 5x Preset Terms; 10x Custom Translations Entries; 10x Image Translations per Language). Starter $4.99 a month (FREE AI for 400 products, 400 metafields and 50 articles; up to 3 AI Languages; 20x Preset Terms; 100x Custom Translations Entries). Basic $19.99 a month (FREE AI for 1500 products, 1500 metafields and 150 articles; up to 10 AI Languages; unlimited Preset Terms). Pro $29.99 a month (FREE AI for 3000 products, 3000 metafields and 300 articles; up to 20 AI Languages; Auto AI Translations; 100x AI Image Translations per month with Basic Engine, or unlimited usage with your own API key). Auto AI Translations is listed only on the Pro card. Differences with the dossier: Basic is $19.99 a month in the app, where the dossier has $14.99 (Starter $4.99 and Pro $29.99 agree); the dossier says only the upper plans re-translate by themselves and asks which tier carries it, and in the app that is Pro only. Checkout: Subscribe on Starter opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription for the Starter Plan: $4,99 USD every 30 days, an app spending limit (You'll be charged based on how you use this app, to a maximum of $30,00 USD per 30 days), Total Due 17 Nov $4,99 (plus any applicable taxes; the screen says usage charges come on top and appear on the invoices), a greyed out Approve button and the row Add payment method. The text You will not be billed for this test charge was NOT on the screen and a payment method was needed, so we did not approve and pressed Cancel. Nothing was approved or paid. Cancelling: the Free plan has no subscription to cancel and no paid plan was started. The way to stop is to uninstall the app. Not tested: publishing the language in the shop (it needs a market and possibly a theme change), an own OpenAI or DeepSeek key, translating images, App Widgets (text of third-party apps), Auto AI Translations (Pro), Preset Terms, the quality of anything beyond the title, and the paid plans. Clean up: the language Dutch was deleted in the app (Languages, bin, Yes, delete) and the list said Languages added: 0 out of 20 again; Shopify may send an export of the translations to the account e-mail when a language is deleted, which Shopify does and not we. The language was never published, no theme change was saved and no paid plan was started. The app was uninstalled in Settings, Apps with the reason Testing multiple apps at about 17:00, and Shopify said You've successfully uninstalled Easy Advanced Translations. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: There is no choice for a single product, all products go along; a language enabled for AI translations can only be removed by deleting it from the store; the handle was not translated; Basic costs $19.99 where the dossier says $14.99; the Starter approval screen asked for a payment method without a test charge sentence; and the translations were not seen in the shop because the language was never published.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. Install: the install was started at 16:42 in our own tab and the dialog This app needs access to (View customer data, View staff and contributor data, View and edit store data) was approved at about 16:44. The admin was in English. The app opened straight on the Plans tab with the Free plan active: no payment, no account on the vendor site and no card were asked.
